original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚塔拉巴州村庄遭匪徒袭击 死亡人数升至50人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚东部塔拉巴州北部村庄Binnari于周五遭骑摩托车武装分子袭击，幸存者向法新社表示，随着更多遗体被发现，死亡人数已升至50人。据信袭击者为当地所称的“匪徒”犯罪团伙，袭击中杀害数十人并抢劫商铺。塔拉巴州面临以经济利益为动机的匪徒团伙袭击，目前该事件为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Binnari, in the north-east of Taraba State, eastern Nigeria

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚塔拉巴州Binnari村遭武装分子袭击，死亡人数升至50人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The death toll from an attack by gunmen on a rural village in eastern Nigeria on Friday has risen to 50, survivors told AFP on Sunday, after more bodies were discovered.

key_facts.fact: 袭击者据信为骑摩托车的当地“匪徒”犯罪团伙，杀害数十人并抢劫商铺
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Armed men believed to belong to a criminal gang, locally known as "bandits", arrived on motorcycles on Friday and stormed Binnari, in the north-east of Taraba State, killing dozens of people and looting shops.

key_facts.fact: 塔拉巴州面临以经济利益为动机的匪徒团伙袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Taraba State, in the east of the country, also faces attacks by bandit gangs motivated by financial gain rather than ideology.

uncertainties: 死亡人数50人来自幸存者向法新社的单方面陈述，尚未获独立核实
袭击者身份仅为“据信”属于匪徒团伙，尚未确认
目前仅有一个来源（Africanews/法新社）报道，缺乏交叉验证
